blocks.en:
The basic definition of a Sobolev space describes it as a subspace of $L^p(\Omega)$. Of course, there is much more to be said, and in this section we describe some of the most important ways that functions in a Sobolev space can be characterized.

In most of this section, we shall confine our discussions to the case $p=2$. Many of the results we discuss have analogues for general $p$, for which we refer to the literature.
blocks.zh:
Sobolev 空间的基本定义将其描述为 $L^p(\Omega)$ 的子空间. 当然, 还有许多内容可讨论, 本节将介绍刻画 Sobolev 空间中函数的一些最重要方式.

在本节的大部分内容中, 将把讨论限于 $p=2$ 的情形. 所讨论的许多结果对一般 $p$ 都有类似结论, 对此请读者参阅文献.

blocks.zh: 关于区域 $\Omega$ 的一些说明
blocks.label: subsec:sobolev-domain-boundary-hypotheses

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The answers to a number of questions about Sobolev spaces depend on assumptions on the regularity of the boundary of $\Omega$.\footnote{In this rather short treatment of Sobolev spaces, we have chosen to avoid most questions of boundary smoothness. For a more complete study of the subject we recommend the paper of Fraenkel \cite{Fr}.} Most of the time, we shall assume a smooth boundary. Specifically, we make the following definition.
blocks.zh: 许多有关 Sobolev 空间的问题, 其答案依赖于对 $\Omega$ 的边界正则性的假设.\footnote{在这里对 Sobolev 空间的简短介绍中, 选择避开大多数边界光滑性问题. 关于这一主题的更完整研究, 推荐 Fraenkel 的论文 \cite{Fr}.} 大多数时候将假设边界光滑. 具体地, 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $\Omega$ is of class $C^k$, $k\geq1$, if every point on $\partial\Omega$ has a neighborhood $N$ so that $\partial\Omega\cap N$ is a $C^k$-surface and, moreover, $\Omega\cap N$ is ``on one side'' of $\partial\Omega\cap N$.
blocks.zh: 若 $\partial\Omega$ 上每个点都有邻域 $N$, 使 $\partial\Omega\cap N$ 为 $C^k$ 曲面, 并且 $\Omega\cap N$ 位于 $\partial\Omega\cap N$ 的 ``一侧'', 则称 $\Omega$ 为 $C^k$ 类, $k\geq1$.
blocks.label: def:c-k-domain-boundary

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
If $\Omega$ is a bounded domain, i.e., connected, the last assumption is redundant; cf. Remark~\ref{rem:boundary-one-side-jordan}.

There are two classes of problems in applications, where nonsmooth domains are relevant:\begin{enumerate}
\item domains with corners, and
\item free boundary problems where $\Omega$ is a priori unknown.
\end{enumerate}It turns out that in fact many results on Sobolev spaces do not require a smooth boundary. Instead, various geometric conditions such as the ``segment property'' and ``cone property'' (cf. \cite{Fr}) need to be assumed. We shall not discuss these conditions here, but we shall state some results for Lipschitz domains.
blocks.zh:
若 $\Omega$ 为有界区域, 即连通, 则最后一个假设是多余的; 参见 Remark~\ref{rem:boundary-one-side-jordan}.

在应用中有两类问题涉及非光滑区域:\begin{enumerate}
\item 有角点的区域, 以及
\item 其中 $\Omega$ 事先未知的自由边界问题.
\end{enumerate}事实上, Sobolev 空间的许多结果并不要求光滑边界. 取而代之, 需要假设 ``线段性质'' 和 ``锥性质'' 等各种几何条件 (参见 \cite{Fr}). 这里不讨论这些条件, 但将陈述 Lipschitz 区域的一些结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $\Omega$ is \textbf{Lipschitz} if every point on $\partial\Omega$ has a neighborhood $N$ such that, after an affine change of coordinates (translation and rotation), $\partial\Omega\cap N$ is described by the equation $x_m=\phi(x_1,\ldots,x_{m-1})$, where $\phi$ is \textbf{uniformly Lipschitz continuous}. Moreover, $\Omega\cap N$ is on one side of $\partial\Omega\cap N$, e.g., $\Omega\cap N=\{\bm{x}\in N\mid x_m<\phi(x_1,\ldots,x_{m-1})\}$.
blocks.zh: 若 $\partial\Omega$ 上每个点都有邻域 $N$, 使在作仿射坐标变换 (平移和旋转) 后, $\partial\Omega\cap N$ 可由方程 $x_m=\phi(x_1,\ldots,x_{m-1})$ 描述, 其中 $\phi$ \textbf{一致 Lipschitz 连续}, 则称 $\Omega$ 为 \textbf{Lipschitz} 区域. 此外, $\Omega\cap N$ 位于 $\partial\Omega\cap N$ 的一侧, 例如 $\Omega\cap N=\{\bm{x}\in N\mid x_m<\phi(x_1,\ldots,x_{m-1})\}$.
blocks.label: def:lipschitz-domain

blocks.en:
If $\Omega$ is unbounded, then, in addition to smoothness conditions on $\partial\Omega$, one needs to impose conditions which say that $\Omega$ is well behaved at infinity. We shall not give a general discussion of such conditions, and many results will be stated only for the case when $\partial\Omega$ is bounded.

Finally, we define a characterization of the domain $\Omega$ that will be very useful as a concise technical hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
若 $\Omega$ 无界, 则除了对 $\partial\Omega$ 的光滑性条件以外, 还需要施加表明 $\Omega$ 在无穷远处行为良好的条件. 这里不一般地讨论这些条件, 许多结果将只对 $\partial\Omega$ 有界的情形陈述.

最后, 定义区域 $\Omega$ 的一种刻画, 它作为简洁的技术性假设将十分有用.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $\Omega$ has the \textbf{$k$-extension property} if there is a bounded linear mapping $E:H^k(\Omega)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ such that $Eu|_{\Omega}=u$ for every $u\in H^k(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 若存在有界线性映射 $E:H^k(\Omega)\to H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 使对每个 $u\in H^k(\Omega)$ 有 $Eu|_{\Omega}=u$, 则称 $\Omega$ 具有\textbf{$k$ 阶延拓性质}.
blocks.label: def:sobolev-k-extension-property

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It is of course trivial that, conversely, the restriction of every function in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ is in $H^k(\Omega)$. The extension property will be investigated in a later subsection; it turns out that bounded Lipschitz domains have the extension property for every $k$.
blocks.zh: 反过来, $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中每个函数的限制属于 $H^k(\Omega)$, 这当然是显然的. 将在后面的一小节中研究延拓性质; 事实上, 有界 Lipschitz 区域对每个 $k$ 都具有延拓性质.
